from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class DocumentExtract(BaseModel):
    """Captures key facts from a single judgment document needed to match against a list of results."""
    doc_title: str | None = Field(description="Identifier of the document (e.g., '判决文书1')")
    case_category: str | None = Field(description="Legal procedure type (e.g., '再审申请', '二审民事', '执行复议')")
    parties: list[str] = Field(description="Names of involved parties (appellants, applicants, etc.)")
    outcome_text: str | None = Field(description="Core judgment outcome (e.g., '驳回上诉，维持原判')")
    case_number: str | None = Field(description="Case reference number if present")
    fee_payers: list[str] = Field(description="Parties ordered to bear court costs")
    fee_amount: float | None = Field(description="Amount of court costs ordered")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    documents: list[DocumentExtract]
